gempauth-unavailable: Login error when GEMP cannot be reached or answers wrongly.
gempauth-banned: Login error for a permanently banned GEMP account.
gempauth-temp-banned: Login error for a suspended GEMP account. $1 - end of the suspension.
gempauth-rate-limited: Login error when GEMP rate-limits. $1 - wait duration.
gempauth-reset-required: Login error for an admin-reset GEMP account. $1 - GEMP URL.
gempauth-name-mismatch: Login error when the typed name maps differently from GEMP's canonical name.
gempauth-link-mismatch: Login error when the wiki name is linked to another GEMP id.
gempauth-password-on-gemp: Shown instead of the wiki password change/reset for GEMP-linked accounts. $1 - GEMP URL.
gempauth-confirm-email-to-edit: Permission error for users without a confirmed email on content pages.
